weapon.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Def+5 to unit during combat, inflicts Atk/Def-X on foe during combat (X = 25% of unit's HP at start of combat; max 10), and restores 10 HP to unit after combat.

At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Def+5 to unit during combat, inflicts Atk/Def-X on foe during combat (X = 25% of unit's HP at start of combat; max 10), and restores 10 HP to unit after combat.

assist.d:
Unit and target ally swap HP.
(Neither can go above their max HP.)

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

b.d: At start of turn, inflicts Def-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Def through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Def/Res-3 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Def+Res total through its next action.
At start of turn, inflicts Def/Res-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Def+Res total through its next action.
